selected_scope.title: LC Office V81 Integration
selected_scope.finding: S1.42AJ remains the balanced lifecycle candidate and is not accepted. Its full-normal Offense evidence already proves LC Office viability at author rarity 65 and final normalized effective rarity 100. S1.42AJ-DIAG1 successfully force-selected and generated LC Office on Offense; runtime evidence is ingested at RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AJ-DIAG1/20260917T204918Z/ (LogOutput.log SHA-256 bb81a91f2cabcb1a3b010dd988335cc9c9cb0b5bcc9bd646ee2ac18ccbb15a26). The user reported frequent afternoon-time stutter at roughly 3-4 hitches per second. Log comparison downgraded the initial NavMesh-error hypothesis because accepted S1.42AI already exhibited far larger Failed-to-create-agent warning volume plus some RuntimeNavMeshBuilder readability noise. The strongest low-risk A/B hypothesis is LC Office CameraCulling: upstream LC Office code periodically calls Camera.Render() at configured Camera Frame Speed (default 10 FPS), and its existing config treats Camera Frame Speed = 0 as camera rendering disabled. This is not yet proven causal. The next diagnostic must isolate only that variable.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Preserve all existing S1.42AJ and S1.42AJ-DIAG1 evidence. Do not promote or reject balanced S1.42AJ yet. Build a strictly diagnostic S1.42AJ-DIAG2 from exact S1.42AJ-DIAG1 with no package or DLL changes and exactly one config delta: BepInEx/config/Piggy.LCOffice.cfg [General] Camera Frame Speed = 0. Keep DIAG1 force-selection unchanged so Office generation remains deterministic. Statically prove the only additional delta is that config value, then arm DIAG2 for an Offense A/B runtime test focused on whether the reported 3-4-per-second stutter disappears or materially decreases while generation/traversal/elevator/scrap/enemy behavior remains healthy. If the hypothesis is confirmed, any balanced successor must be derived from exact balanced S1.42AJ, not from a diagnostic profile. Universal-moon availability and unrelated Interior scopes remain out of scope.
selected_scope.next_action: Prepare and build a strictly one-variable S1.42AJ-DIAG2 from exact S1.42AJ-DIAG1: preserve the diagnostic LC Office force-selection and every package/DLL/config except set BepInEx/config/Piggy.LCOffice.cfg [General] Camera Frame Speed = 0. Statically verify that exact delta, publish/arm DIAG2, then runtime A/B test on Offense specifically for the previously observed frequent afternoon-time stutter. Do not alter balanced S1.42AJ or infer causality before the A/B result.
